title: v8.3 ridge + three untested feature families (each its own trial, judged separately)
model: v8.3 ridge unchanged (kimchi breadth, vol-scaled target, monthly walk-forward from 2021, alpha 10) plus ONE added feature set per trial

trials.A: variance risk premium: vrp = DVOL/100/sqrt(365) - vol30 (implied minus realised daily vol, per coin), and its 7-day change
trials.B: change in Korean risk appetite: kb - kb 7 days earlier (kb = mean altcoin kimchi z, already a feature)
trials.C: calendar: weekend dummy (decision day Fri/Sat, i.e. the target day is Sat/Sun) and Monday-target dummy

why: A: the VRP predicts returns in equities (Bollerslev-Tauchen-Zhou) and only DVOL changes are in the ridge so far; B: the ridge has the breadth level but not its momentum; C: crypto weekend returns differ (lower liquidity), never offered to the ridge
pass: per trial: sleeve D 2021-22 > 0, TEST >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5 and strict rule vs v8.3 (2.700 / 1.293 / 3.828 / 2.376); if more than one passes, the higher book Sharpe is adopted, combination only as a new registered trial
